verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows 1Password accepting natural-language commands itself; its documented operating surfaces are the op CLI, the SDKs and REST APIs. The official Environments MCP server lets third-party agents manage Environments, which is a separate MCP-server capability where the agent client, not 1Password, interprets the language. It is adjacent support and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
